# A 30.00 USD invoice settled from part of the customer's 100.00 USD credit,
# which the block gives by guid so this tool carves it rather than GnuCash.
# 70.00 USD is left, in a remainder split of its own.
#
# `auto_apply_credit: true` must not be used here. On 3.8, 4.4 and 4.13 the
# engine's own application rewrites the credit split's value at par — −100.00
# where −137.00 belongs — and adds a balancing 37.00 USD split to cover the
# difference, so the book under test would be a different book on those builds.
# See CLAUDE.md finding 19.
invoice "INV-FX-PART-CREDIT"
	customer_id: "C-FX"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-03-10
	entry:
		date: 2026-03-10
		description: "Further consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 30
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-03-10
		due: 2026-04-10
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-FX-PART-CREDIT"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		amount: 100.00
		from_credit: true
		credit_dated: 2026-02-25
		txn_guid: "TXN_GUID"
		txn_split_guid: "SPLIT_GUID"
